turns.user: Which published cement pastes have a plastic viscosity of 20 Pa.s or less together with a mini-slump flow diameter of at least 180 mm?
turns.text:
I’ll query the literature database, first checking its schema as required, then filter for mixes reporting both properties.
The database rejected the trailing statement terminator as a second statement; I’ve removed it and am retrying the same read-only query.
The validator also treats a semicolon inside a text separator as a statement boundary. I’ve replaced that separator and am retrying once more.
The cement-component filter timed out because it repeatedly scanned components for each measurement pair. I’m rewriting it as three pre-deduplicated mix lists and retrying.
The database contains **95 qualifying cement-containing paste records from 9 papers**. I treated “cement paste” as `system_type = paste` with at least one cement-class component.

input.sql:
WITH pv AS (
  SELECT mix_uid, paper_uid, obs_uid, test_uid,
         CAST(value_canonical AS REAL) AS plastic_viscosity_Pa_s,
         rest_time_norm_s, condition_note, source_locator, fig_only, extraction_confidence
  FROM measurements
  WHERE quantity='plastic_viscosity'
    AND value_canonical <> ''
    AND CAST(value_canonical AS REAL) <= 20
),
ms AS (
  SELECT mix_uid, paper_uid, obs_uid, test_uid,
         CAST(value_canonical AS REAL) AS mini_slump_mm,
         rest_time_norm_s, condition_note, source_locator, fig_only, extraction_confidence
  FROM measurements
  WHERE quantity='mini_slump_flow_diameter'
    AND value_canonical <> ''
    AND CAST(value_canonical AS REAL) >= 180
)
SELECT p.year, p.title, p.authors, p.doi, p.journal,
       m.mix_uid, m.name_in_paper AS mix_name, m.w_b_reported,
       pv.plastic_viscosity_Pa_s, ms.mini_slump_mm,
       tpv.method_name AS viscosity_method, tms.method_name AS mini_slump_method,
       pv.rest_time_norm_s AS viscosity_rest_s, ms.rest_time_norm_s AS slump_rest_s,
       pv.condition_note AS viscosity_condition, ms.condition_note AS slump_condition,
       pv.source_locator AS viscosity_source, ms.source_locator AS slump_source,
       pv.fig_only AS viscosity_fig_only, ms.fig_only AS slump_fig_only,
       pv.extraction_confidence AS viscosity_confidence,
       ms.extraction_confidence AS slump_confidence,
       (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(mat.material_class || CASE
           WHEN mc.dosage_reported IS NOT NULL AND mc.dosage_reported<>'' THEN ':'||mc.dosage_reported||COALESCE(' '||mc.unit_reported,'')
           ELSE '' END, '; ')
        FROM mix_components mc
        JOIN materials mat ON mat.material_uid=mc.material_uid
        WHERE mc.mix_uid=m.mix_uid) AS components
FROM pv
JOIN ms ON ms.mix_uid=pv.mix_uid
JOIN mixes m ON m.mix_uid=pv.mix_uid
JOIN papers p ON p.paper_uid=m.paper_uid
LEFT JOIN tests tpv ON tpv.test_uid=pv.test_uid
LEFT JOIN tests tms ON tms.test_uid=ms.test_uid
WHERE m.system_type='paste'
ORDER BY CAST(p.year AS INTEGER), p.doi, m.mix_uid, pv.plastic_viscosity_Pa_s, ms.mini_slump_mm

WITH q AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT m.mix_uid, m.paper_uid
 FROM mixes m
 JOIN measurements pv ON pv.mix_uid=m.mix_uid
 JOIN measurements ms ON ms.mix_uid=m.mix_uid
 WHERE m.system_type='paste'
   AND pv.quantity='plastic_viscosity' AND pv.value_canonical<>''
   AND CAST(pv.value_canonical AS REAL)<=20
   AND ms.quantity='mini_slump_flow_diameter' AND ms.value_canonical<>''
   AND CAST(ms.value_canonical AS REAL)>=180
)
SELECT p.year,p.title,p.authors,p.doi,p.journal,
       COUNT(*) AS qualifying_mix_count,
       GROUP_CONCAT(m.name_in_paper, ', ') AS qualifying_mix_names
FROM q
JOIN papers p ON p.paper_uid=q.paper_uid
JOIN mixes m ON m.mix_uid=q.mix_uid
GROUP BY p.paper_uid
ORDER BY CAST(p.year AS INTEGER),p.doi

input.sql:
WITH q AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT m.mix_uid,m.paper_uid
 FROM mixes m
 JOIN measurements pv ON pv.mix_uid=m.mix_uid
 JOIN measurements ms ON ms.mix_uid=m.mix_uid
 WHERE m.system_type='paste'
   AND pv.quantity='plastic_viscosity' AND pv.value_canonical<>''
   AND CAST(pv.value_canonical AS REAL)<=20
   AND ms.quantity='mini_slump_flow_diameter' AND ms.value_canonical<>''
   AND CAST(ms.value_canonical AS REAL)>=180
)
SELECT p.doi,m.name_in_paper AS mix_name,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT mat.material_class) AS material_classes
FROM q
JOIN mixes m ON m.mix_uid=q.mix_uid
JOIN papers p ON p.paper_uid=q.paper_uid
LEFT JOIN mix_components mc ON mc.mix_uid=q.mix_uid
LEFT JOIN materials mat ON mat.material_uid=mc.material_uid
GROUP BY q.mix_uid
ORDER BY p.doi,m.mix_uid

WITH q AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT m.mix_uid,m.paper_uid
 FROM mixes m
 JOIN measurements pv ON pv.mix_uid=m.mix_uid
 JOIN measurements ms ON ms.mix_uid=m.mix_uid
 WHERE m.system_type='paste'
   AND pv.quantity='plastic_viscosity' AND pv.value_canonical<>''
   AND CAST(pv.value_canonical AS REAL)<=20
   AND ms.quantity='mini_slump_flow_diameter' AND ms.value_canonical<>''
   AND CAST(ms.value_canonical AS REAL)>=180
   AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM mix_components mc
      JOIN materials mat ON mat.material_uid=mc.material_uid
      WHERE mc.mix_uid=m.mix_uid AND mat.material_class LIKE '%cement%'
   )
)
SELECT p.year,p.title,p.authors,p.doi,p.journal,
       COUNT(*) AS qualifying_mix_count,
       GROUP_CONCAT(m.name_in_paper, ', ') AS qualifying_mix_names
FROM q
JOIN papers p ON p.paper_uid=q.paper_uid
JOIN mixes m ON m.mix_uid=q.mix_uid
GROUP BY p.paper_uid
ORDER BY CAST(p.year AS INTEGER),p.doi

input.sql:
SELECT m.name_in_paper,mat.material_class,mat.name_in_paper,
       mc.role,mc.dosage_reported,mc.unit_reported,mc.basis_reported
FROM mixes m
JOIN mix_components mc ON mc.mix_uid=m.mix_uid
JOIN materials mat ON mat.material_uid=mc.material_uid
WHERE m.mix_uid='10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2020.120381::M5'
   OR (m.paper_uid='10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2020.120381' AND m.name_in_paper='AASG-4')
ORDER BY m.mix_uid,mc.component_uid

WITH pv AS (
 SELECT mix_uid,
        MIN(CAST(value_canonical AS REAL)) AS pv_min,
        MAX(CAST(value_canonical AS REAL)) AS pv_max
 FROM measurements
 WHERE quantity='plastic_viscosity' AND value_canonical<>''
   AND CAST(value_canonical AS REAL)<=20
 GROUP BY mix_uid
),
ms AS (
 SELECT mix_uid,
        MIN(CAST(value_canonical AS REAL)) AS slump_min,
        MAX(CAST(value_canonical AS REAL)) AS slump_max
 FROM measurements
 WHERE quantity='mini_slump_flow_diameter' AND value_canonical<>''
   AND CAST(value_canonical AS REAL)>=180
 GROUP BY mix_uid
),
cm AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT mc.mix_uid
 FROM mix_components mc
 JOIN materials mat ON mat.material_uid=mc.material_uid
 WHERE mat.material_class LIKE '%cement%'
),
q AS (
 SELECT m.mix_uid,m.paper_uid,m.name_in_paper,pv.pv_min,pv.pv_max,ms.slump_min,ms.slump_max
 FROM mixes m
 JOIN pv ON pv.mix_uid=m.mix_uid
 JOIN ms ON ms.mix_uid=m.mix_uid
 JOIN cm ON cm.mix_uid=m.mix_uid
 WHERE m.system_type='paste'
)
SELECT p.year,p.doi,
       COUNT(*) AS mixes,
       MIN(q.pv_min) AS viscosity_min_Pa_s,
       MAX(q.pv_max) AS viscosity_max_Pa_s,
       MIN(q.slump_min) AS mini_slump_min_mm,
       MAX(q.slump_max) AS mini_slump_max_mm,
       GROUP_CONCAT(q.name_in_paper, ', ') AS mix_names
FROM q
JOIN papers p ON p.paper_uid=q.paper_uid
GROUP BY p.paper_uid
ORDER BY CAST(p.year AS INTEGER),p.doi
